purpose: Make every accepted parent package understandable, operable and auditable without reconstructing child-package history.
rules: The chapter explains why and how the package works in analyst language; it does not replace executable contracts or tests.
Claims must be backed by accepted child-package evidence and current authoritative provider documentation where applicable.
Open, deferred or unsupported behavior must be stated explicitly and cannot be described as complete.
No secret, plaintext token, personal data or raw sensitive provider payload may enter the chapter.
A parent cannot advance the master plan until the chapter, technical evidence and explicit product-owner closure agree.
Later corrections are forward-only and preserve historical accepted evidence.

ci_enforcement.rule: Every parent whose master-plan status is Done or Accepted must have an accepted ledger entry and readable Analysis-Design Book; otherwise CI fails.
